author: kingpanther13
releaseNotes:
v5.2.2 - 2026-11-27
- ci: start ephemeral hub jobs after fast checks pass (#598)
- ci: make the ephemeral fast-CI gate wait instead of deferring (#600)
- ci: resume deferred hub runs from workflow_run and gate the physical e2e on fast CI (#602)
- fix: hub_get_app_config hang on a raw '<'; hub_get_logs refusals name each mode's arguments (#606)
  - `hub_get_app_config` no longer hangs on a large Rule Machine rule whose action text contains `<`, and no longer drops action text that comes before a `{...}` block.
  - App page and native form reads no longer drop text after a `<` that is directly followed by a letter, such as `a<b`.
  - `hub_get_logs` refuses a `pattern` that uses a backreference (`\1`, `\k<name>`).
  - `hub_get_app_config`: the title of the Local Variables table button on a Rule Machine page no longer includes the page's CSS.
  - `hub_get_logs`: when an argument does not apply to a log mode, the error says which arguments that mode takes and which modes the argument applies to.
  - `hub_get_logs(mode='mcp')` accepts `pattern`, `patterns` and `patternMode`.

v5.2.1 - 2026-11-21
- docs: change the watchdog only when CI or repair needs it (#597)
- feat: rebuild the File Manager tools on the hub's own listing (#586)
  - Deleting a File Manager file that does not exist now says so instead of reporting a successful delete.
  - Writing a file with the content it already has no longer rewrites it.
  - File listings are smaller and give sizes and dates as numbers; reading a missing file, or asking for a bad offset or length, gives a clear error.
  - Writing over a file whose current content can't be read is now refused instead of overwriting it without a backup copy.
  - Using a folder name, a subfolder path or a name the hub can't hold as a file name gives a clear error.

v5.2.0 - 2026-11-17
- feat: five dashboard tools instead of six (copy via hub_create_dashboard) (#581)
  - Dashboard tools are simpler: five tools instead of six.
    - Copy a dashboard with `hub_create_dashboard` and a `sourceId` (replaces `hub_clone_dashboard`); you can name the copy.
  - Reading a legacy Hubitat® Dashboard and confirming a dashboard delete each need fewer hub requests.
  - Updating a dashboard that no longer exists now says so instead of failing with an unclear hub error, and a legacy tile with a misspelled field is refused by name.
  - Dashboards follow the MCP device selection: unless Bypass Device Allowlist is on, a dashboard can't be given (or lose) a device MCP isn't allowed to use.
  - Two legacy dashboard edits sent at the same time no longer lose one of the changes.
  - An Easy Dashboard's "Local access only" setting is kept when you rename, update or copy the dashboard.
  - Legacy dashboard tiles can use the hub editor's own fields, such as a hub-variable tile's variable or a link tile's caption.
  - Pointing a dashboard tool at an app that isn't a dashboard now says "No dashboard found" instead of a misleading error.
  - The dashboard list can be read a page at a time on hubs with many dashboards.
